To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the performance of the different methods is highly dependent on the type of the score function, the number of variables, the type of the variables (discrete or continuous) and, to a lower extent, on the rate of noise in the training set.

(a) the score-based methods perform better than the constraint-based ones, and the BDeu score is the most suitable one; (b) the MCMC-based methods are the most effective ones for the inference; and (c) the best performance can be achieved by combining the MCMC and BDeu algorithms.

the performance of different methods depends on the characteristics of the BN and on the characteristics of data, and that the most effective methods are the ones that combine different approaches and/or use multiple scores.

a quantitative analysis of how different algorithmic approaches affect the quality of the learned structure.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, in general, the performance of the algorithms for learning the BN structure from data is not satisfactory.
the best performing method for structural learning is the one that combines the most accurate score with the most efficient algorithmic scheme.
, when dealing with discrete data, the performance of different algorithms is comparable, while the choice of a specific score is not so important.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the score-based methods are not always the best choice for structural learning, but the use of a good heuristic can make a difference.

the performance of the algorithms is not affected by the type of the BNs, i.e., discrete or continuous, but it is highly influenced by the noise in the data and by the type of score function used for learning the network.
the best performing method is the one that is the most time consuming and computationally expensive.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in the presence of noise, the performance of the different methods is strongly dependent on the type of the variables and on the score function used.
the score and search method are the two main factors that influence the quality of the learned structure and that the score function is the most critical one.
the score and search method used in the structural learning procedure can have a huge impact on the quality of the learned structure.
